dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: A commendable picture. A perfect memento for the occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: My thanks. I will treat it as one of my personal effects and take care of it accordingly.

choices.text: About the Xiao Lantern I released...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Yes, I saw it. I intend to purchase some Xiao Lanterns to take back to Inazuma after this. They will look quite nice hanging at the entrance of the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: With Doushin Shikanoin around, I doubt any thieves would dare lay hands on them.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Thank you, happy Lantern Rite to you as well... But if I may ask, does the Millelith always maintain such strict vigilance during Lantern Rite?

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: To maintain such strict discipline even amidst the festivities... I'm impressed.
